meta.name: poetry-music-visual
meta.description: 为古诗词提供配图与配乐的全流程创作指导；支持深度解析诗词意境、生成画面描述、提供配乐创作蓝图（Suno格式）；适用于诗词可视化、MV创作、文化传播等场景

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为古诗词生成配图与配乐创作方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想把古诗词转化为视听作品
copy.tagline_en: Generate visual and music creation plans for classical poetry
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to transform classical poetry into audiovisual works

howto.what: 用户给出一首古诗词后，Claude会解析其意象、情感与文化背景，生成2-3组配图场景描述，并输出Suno格式的配乐蓝图（风格标签+结构指令），再统一画面与音乐风格。
howto.when: 当用户要求为古诗词配图、配乐或制作诗词MV时触发。

say.text: 给李白的《静夜思》配图和配乐。
say.note: 会输出配图描述和Suno配乐蓝图。

say.text: 用《山居秋暝》做MV，先出配图方案。
把这首词的配乐改成激昂风格，用国潮乐器。
say.note: 会调整风格标签与结构。

howto.what_en: When a user provides an ancient poem, Claude analyzes its imagery, emotion, and cultural context, produces 2-3 visual scene descriptions for illustration, and outputs a Suno-format music blueprint (style tags + structure directives), then checks consistency between visuals and music.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for an illustration, soundtrack, or MV production for an ancient poem.

say_en.text: Create an image and a soundtrack for Li Bai's 'Quiet Night Thoughts'.
say_en.note: Outputs scene descriptions and a Suno blueprint.

say_en.text: Make an MV for 'Dwelling in the Mountains in Autumn Evening'—start with image concepts.
Change the music mood to epic and use Chinese-style instruments.
